Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련을 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 처음부터 해보겠다고 이야기 한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Having failed the training, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> says she wants to start over from the beginning.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニングに失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、もう一度最初からやってみると言ってきた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 训练失败的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>表示想从头再来一次。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 訓練失敗的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>表示想從頭再來一次。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, ayant échoué l'entraînement, dit qu'il/elle va recommencer depuis le début.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sagte, dass er das Training von vorne beginnen werde.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien fracasó en el entrenamiento, dice que quiere intentarlo desde el principio.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que falhou no treinamento, disse que tentaria novamente desde o início.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ล้มเหลวในการฝึกซ้อม บอกว่าต้องการลองใหม่ตั้งแต่เริ่มต้น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang gagal dalam latihan mengatakan akan mencoba dari awal.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thất bại trong huấn luyện và nói rằng sẽ thử lại từ đầu.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 너무 무리하지 마. 오늘은 푹 쉬자.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Don't push yourself too hard. Let's get some good rest today.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: あんまり無理しなくていい。今日はゆっくり休もう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 别太勉强自己了，今天先好好休息吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 別太勉強自己了，今天先好好休息吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ne sois pas si stupide. Aujourd'hui, on se repose.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Sei nicht so unvorsichtig. Heute ist ein guter Tag.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No te esfuerces demasiado. Hoy descansa bien.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não seja tão apressado. Hoje é um dia de descanso.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: อย่ารีบร้อนนัก วันนี้พักผ่อนนะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Jangan terlalu bersemangat. Hari ini kita istirahat.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đừng vội vàng. Hôm nay ta sẽ nghỉ ngơi.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: I'll be right here beside you. Let's take it slow.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 私が傍にいるよ。焦らず、ゆっくりやってみよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 我会陪在你身边，慢慢来就好。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 我會陪在你身邊，慢慢來就好。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ich werde bei dir sein. Mal sehen, was passiert.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Yo te ayudaré. Vamos a intentarlo.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Eu estarei ao seu lado. Vamos tentar devagar.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: เดี๋ยวฉันจะอยู่ข้างๆ ลองทำดูนะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Aku akan menemanimu. Ayo kita coba perlahan.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Để ta lo liệu. Cứ từ từ thử xem.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: I hope this lifts your spirits, at least a little.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: とりあえず、これ飲んで。少しは楽になるかも。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 希望喝了茶之后能打起精神。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 希望喝了茶之後能打起精神。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Même si tu bois ça, ça te redonnera un peu d'énergie.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wenn du das auch isst, wird es besser.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Si bebes esto, te sentirás mejor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Se você beber isso, talvez consiga se recuperar um pouco.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ลองดื่มแล้วค่อยๆ หายใจให้ลึกหน่อยนะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kalau kau minum ini sambil istirahat, mungkin akan lebih baik.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Ăn cái này rồi uống chút rượu thì tốt nhỉ.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thanked me, determined to do better next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は次の機会を楽しみにしながら、感謝の言葉を伝えた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>表示会期待下次机会，并向你道谢。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>表示會期待下次機會，並向你道謝。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a exprimé sa gratitude en espérant une prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> drückte seine Dankbarkeit aus und freute sich auf das nächste Mal.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> expresó su gratitud y se despidió esperando el próximo encuentro.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> agradeceu e prometeu ajudar na próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สัญญาว่าจะกลับมาครั้งต่อไปและขอบคุณ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berjanji untuk putaran berikutnya dan menyampaikan rasa terima kasih.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> gửi lời cảm ơn và hẹn sẽ cố gắng lần tới.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 기운이 없는 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 옆에서 잠시 쉬기로 했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I decided to rest for a while beside <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, who seemed downcast.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 元気のない<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>のそばで、しばらく休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 决定暂时陪在没精神的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>身边休息。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 決定暫時陪在沒精神的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>身邊休息。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Je me suis reposé un moment près de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> qui semblait sans énergie.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich beschloss, mich kurz neben dem niedergeschlagenen <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Decidí descansar brevemente junto a <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien se veía sin energía.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Descansarei um pouco perto de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que está sem energia.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันนั่งลงพักสักครู่ข้างๆ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ดูเหนื่อยไม่มีกำลัง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Aku memutuskan untuk beristirahat sebentar di samping <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang terlihat lesu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi quyết định nghỉ ngơi một chút bên cạnh <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đang thiếu sinh khí.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 다시 집중한 끝에 만족스럽게 성공할 수 있었다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After regaining her focus, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> succeeded, to her satisfaction.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再び集中し、ついに満足のいく結果を出すことができた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>重新集中精神后，顺利获得了满意的成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>重新集中精神後，順利獲得了滿意的成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a finalement réussi avec satisfaction après s'être concentré à nouveau.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> konnte am Ende seiner erneuten Konzentration zufrieden erfolgreich sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> finalmente logró tener éxito satisfactoriamente tras concentrarse de nuevo.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> conseguiu sucesso satisfatoriamente após se concentrar novamente.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สามารถประสบความสำเร็จได้อย่างน่าพอใจหลังจากมีสมาธิสูง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> akhirnya berhasil dengan memuaskan setelah kembali berkonsentrasi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> cuối cùng đã có thể thành công một cách thỏa mãn sau khi tập trung lại.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> failed yet again and sank into despair...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はまたしても失敗し、すっかり落ち込んでしまった…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a échoué à nouveau et s'est enfoncée dans le désespoir...
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ist erneut gescheitert und verfiel in Verzweiflung...
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> falló nuevamente y cayó en la desesperación...
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> falhou novamente e caiu no desânimo...
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ล้มเหลวอีกครั้งและตกอยู่ในความสิ้นหวัง…
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> gagal lagi dan jatuh ke dalam keputusasaan...
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lại thất bại và rơi vào tuyệt vọng...

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 감사를 전한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 얼굴에 다시금 생기가 돌았다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> offered her thanks and seemed to brighten considerably.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 感謝を伝えた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の面差に、ようやく明るさが戻ってきた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 向你道谢的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>脸上再次恢复了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 向你道謝的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>臉上再次恢復了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Le visage de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, qui m'avait exprimé sa gratitude, s'illumina à nouveau.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Auf dem Gesicht von <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, das Dankbarkeit ausdrückte, kehrte wieder Leben zurück.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El rostro de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien expresó gratitud, volvió a cobrar vida.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: O rosto de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que transmitiu gratidão, ganhou vida novamente.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ความสดใสกลับมาปรากฏบนใบหน้าของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ส่งกำลังใจมา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Kehidupan kembali bersinar di wajah <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang telah menyampaikan rasa terima kasih.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trên khuôn mặt của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vừa gửi lời cảm ơn, sự sống động lại hiện lên.
